subject: Standard Error Printed as NA for Single Parameter

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Standard Error Printed as NA for Single Parameter
parts:
Hello, 

I'm running a model that produces an NA for a single residual variance parameter and lavaan does not print any error messages when running the model. The point estimate for this specific is .0001, but it is freely estimated and not estimated at 0. I'm hoping someone could explain why lavaan prints an NA in this case, and also whether the delta and weight matrix are still appropriate to use for later calculations that we perform when a single parameter is printed to have NA for a SE. Code used to run the model and model output are attached. Thanks very much in advance for your help!

Best, 
  Andrew

messages.author: a2d9b83cabaa80ae
messages.subject: Re: Standard Error Printed as NA for Single Parameter
parts: It looks like this issue is a function of the sample size entered when you fit the model. If you do N = 4 instead of N = 2, the weight matrix is unchanged but that SE goes from NA to a (small) estimated value.
